title: The Satellite That Caught a Signal From Before the Big Bang
hook: A secret military satellite recorded a signal that predates the universe itself, and no one is allowed to analyze it.
why_this_can_go_viral: Mixes cosmology's biggest mystery with government secrecy—irresistible to conspiracy and space fans.

title: The Star That Refuses to Die—And It's Acting Intelligent
hook: A star has been pulsing in a prime number sequence for 30 years, as if signaling to something—or someone.
why_this_can_go_viral: Turns a natural object into a potential intelligence—hooks both science skeptics and alien believers.

title: The Declassified File That Proves Earth Was Almost Vaporized in 2012
hook: A secret document reveals a gamma ray burst missed Earth by 0.3 light-years—and it was covered up as a solar storm.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines a specific near-extinction event with a government cover-up—the perfect viral conspiracy cocktail.

title: The Apollo 11 Tape That Recorded a Voice From the Void
hook: Astronauts heard a whisper in a language that doesn't exist on Earth—and NASA deleted the audio immediately.
why_this_can_go_viral: Leverages iconic Apollo mission mystery—everyone loves 'what did they really hear?' content.

title: The Asteroid That Wiped Out Dinosaurs—But Came Back 65 Million Years Later
hook: A fragment of the Chicxulub impactor was found in orbit—it returned to Earth and no one knows how.
why_this_can_go_viral: Creates a narrative loop—a killer asteroid that comes back feels like a horror movie premise.

title: The Pulsar That's Sending Messages in a Dead Language

why_this_can_go_viral: Connects cosmic mystery with lost human history—a double intrigue that fuels viral sharing.

title: The Secret Chinese Space Station That Detected a Ghost Galaxy
hook: China's classified Tiangong-2 recorded a galaxy that shouldn't exist—and then it disappeared from all telescopes.
why_this_can_go_viral: Taps into rising interest in Chinese space secrecy—combined with a vanishing galaxy it's pure mystery.

title: The Rogue Planet That Carries a Fossilized City on Its Surface

title: The Coffin-Shaped Asteroid That's Orbiting Earth—Undetected for 50 Years
hook: A 2-mile-long asteroid shaped like a casket has been hiding in Earth's orbital shadow since the 1970s.
why_this_can_go_viral: Visual fear—a coffin shape and secret orbit creates instant dread and thumbnail potential.

title: The Fermi Paradox Answer: They All Turned Into Data and Vanished
hook: A physicist's unpublished theory claims advanced civilizations upload themselves into a hidden dimension—and Earth is next.
why_this_can_go_viral: Taps into transhumanist fear and curiosity—'we’re next' triggers urgency and sharing.

title: The Star That Exploded—And Left Behind a Perfect Cube

why_this_can_go_viral: Visual shock—perfect geometric shapes in space are instantly captivating and meme-worthy.

title: The Dark Matter Ocean That Exists Inside Earth's Core

title: The Comet That Dragged a Fragment of Another Solar System Into Ours

title: The NASA File That Describes a 'Living' Object in the Kuiper Belt
hook: A classified NASA document mentions an object that moves like a living organism—and it's getting closer.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines highest levels of secrecy, life, and threat—the perfect viral bomb.

title: The Signal That Was Broadcast From Inside Earth's Mantle

why_this_can_go_viral: Inverts the extraterrestrial narrative—aliens might be inside Earth, not in space. Fresh and creepy.

title: The Supernova That Wiped Out an Ancient Civilization—And We Have Proof

why_this_can_go_viral: Real-world technological collapse from a cosmic cause—relatable fear and massive share appeal.

title: The Secret Soviet Probe That Found a Door on Venus

why_this_can_go_viral: Leverages cold war space secrecy and a Venus mystery—two huge click-driving factors.

title: The Star That's Orbiting the Galactic Black Hole—And Carrying Alien Tech

why_this_can_go_viral: Directly implies alien engineering around the galaxy's most mysterious object—massive viral potential.
